title: COLLAPSE of Personal Computing | Investigation Into the Destruction of Ownership
summary: A roughly 3.5-hour Gamers Nexus investigation into rising PC component prices, driven largely by AI data-center demand for memory and other hardware. It draws on interviews with industry figures to argue that personal computing and ownership are being eroded.
why: Recommended as a documentary on the hardware shortage told from the perspective of consumer-facing companies, and cited in threads on RAM prices and ownership.

quote.text: GN did a documentary on the situation from the perspective of consumer-facing companies.
